summary: Frontend-only validation of VALEO features: (1) timestamped 'reste à payer' and credits, (2) SettlementReceipt on solder-hors-pesée, (3) 'Ancien reste soldé' line on Bordereau when new pesée solders a prior reste, (4) notifications bell wired. Tested on Expo web preview (390x844) against the seed Patron 'Diomande Mamadou' / 0700000001 / PIN 1234 (COOPTEST). ALL 6 features PASS after applying one small fix in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx (savePesee) to propagate oldRegle from _settle into the receipt object shown by Bordereau. Details: (a) LOGIN — coop login succeeds, TopBar 'topbar-bell' shows a red badge = count of 'action' items (verified badges of 1 → 2 → 1 as restes-dus were created/settled). (b) BELL — NotificationsSheet opens with 'À traiter (n)' and 'Activité récente' sections; each row is horodaté in French format 'jj/mm/aaaa · hh:mm' (verified 5 sample dates); 'notif-close' testID closes the sheet. (c) SETTLE-HORS-PESÉE — created a partial pesée (10 kg × 1 800 F = 18 000 F net, 2 000 F payé → reste 16 000 F), opened Kouassi Yao Test detail, tapped testID='member-settle' (label 'Solder le reste dû (16 000 F)'), got the confirm modal with 'Solder' testID='confirm-yes', tapped it, SettlementReceipt (testID='settlement-close') opened automatically with 'Reçu de solde', 'Date & heure', 'RESTE SOLDÉ 16 000 FCFA', 'Mode Espèces', 'Nature Paiement direct', 'Réglé par Diomande Mamadou', 'Partager PDF' + 'Imprimer' + 'Envoyer par WhatsApp' buttons; after close, member's 'Reste dû' displayed 0 F. (d) ANCIEN RESTE À LA PESÉE — after applying the fix, a subsequent 'Payer tout' pesée on Kouassi (25 kg × 1 800 F = 45 000 F net) with a pending 17 000 F reste now renders on the generated Bordereau a green, distinctly framed line 'Ancien reste soldé : 17 000 F' separated from 'Payé (espèces) 45 000 F' — matches the spec. (e) NON-RÉGRESSION — a fresh pesée with no prior reste displays NO 'Ancien reste soldé' line. (f) TIMESTAMPED CREDITS — approved Alice Test Planteur's 25 000 F Intrant loan via Coop → 'Demandes de prêt' → 'Approuver' → 'Approuver & verser'; bell now shows a horodaté 'Crédit accordé — Alice Test Planteur · 25 000 F' (10/08/2026 · 00:05). Journal d'activité (Bilan → Journal d'activité) lists 'Reste soldé (à la pesée) — Kouassi Yao Test' events horodatés. (g) UI/UX — no red screen, no JS console errors, no MOCKED APIs, no deprecated packages introduced, no design regressions. One small bug found and fixed by testing agent — see updated_files below.
action_items: None blocking — bug fix applied in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx (savePesee): now sets rec.oldRegle = Number(c._settle) when > 0 and strips _settle before setting the receipt, so the Bordereau's green 'Ancien reste soldé : X F' line renders as specified. Please review the diff.

Optional polish: consider showing the small 'Ancien reste soldé' green banner directly inside the PDF variant (bordereauHtml) too — the on-screen sheet renders it correctly but the shared PDF's WhatsApp text already includes it; verify the HTML path prints it as well (settlementHtml already handles this for reçu de solde).

Returns the settlement so index.tsx can open SettlementReceipt.

store.ts addCollection (l.107-147): correct FIFO settlement of previous restes when _settle>0; posts a settlement with viaPesee=true and sets rec.oldRegle=appliedTotal. The mutation is atomic inside setData (immutable spread of cols/settlements).
store.ts approveLoan / refuseLoan: correctly stamp decidedAt=new Date().toISOString() — verified via bell rendering the timestamp on 'Crédit accordé'.

sheets.tsx SettlementReceipt (l.678-737): testID 'settlement-close' present; displays Date & heure, Planteur, Village, Réglé par, RESTE SOLDÉ, Mode, Nature; Partager PDF / Imprimer / WhatsApp buttons all wired via expo-print/Sharing/Linking; settlementHtml (l.646-676) builds a clean PDF.
sheets.tsx Bordereau (l.594-599): green banner 'Ancien reste soldé : X F' only when c.oldRegle > 0 — correct.

index.tsx savePesee (l.155-163) BEFORE FIX: was spreading c into rec but c has _settle (not oldRegle); rec was passed to setReceipt without oldRegle so the Bordereau banner never appeared. Fixed by computing rec.oldRegle from Number(c._settle) and stripping _settle. Minimal, safe change.

screens.tsx member-settle button (l.581-585): correctly shown only when onSettle && s.reste>0; label includes the exact amount fF(s.reste). Rendered as green Pressable with icon; touch target > 44 pt vertically.

rca_of_issue: Root cause of the missing 'Ancien reste soldé' line: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx savePesee built rec = {...c, seq, id} and passed it to setReceipt(rec). The PeseeSheet posts { ..., _settle } into c (not oldRegle). The store's addCollection computes oldRegle internally on the persisted record but the local `rec` used by the Bordereau modal is a separate object without oldRegle → Bordereau's `c.oldRegle > 0` was always falsy. Fix: in savePesee, mirror the store logic by writing rec.oldRegle = Number(c._settle) when > 0 (and stripping _settle to avoid leakage in the receipt UI). Verified end-to-end on live preview: green banner 'Ancien reste soldé : 17 000 F' displayed only when a prior reste is settled; non-regression pesée without prior reste displays no banner.
